Define a content specification for insertion into a document

define_content.Rd

define_content() creates a structured object describing how a piece of content should be inserted into a Markdown/Quarto document. The content is captured as an unevaluated expression and later rendered by downstream tooling (e.g., knitr/Quarto).

Usage

define_content(
  description = NULL,
  placeholder_id,
  output_mode = c("inline", "chunk", "asis"),
  content,
  content_type = NULL,
  chunk_options = list()
)

Arguments

description

An optional label describing the content for ease of validating the content is in the correct place.

placeholder_id

A slug identifying the placeholder (e.g., "plot1"). The full placeholder matched in the Markdown file will be paste0(placeholder_prefix, "_", placeholder_id).

output_mode

One of:

  • "inline" – insert a knitr inline expression using the R engine `r <expr>`.

  • "chunk" – insert a fenced code block. Chunk language defaults to R but can be overridden via chunk_options$engine.

  • "asis" – insert literal text. If content is a character literal, it is inserted as-is; otherwise the expression is deparsed to text and inserted.

content

A quoted or unquoted R expression (captured, not executed). For "inline" and "chunk", this expression is emitted for knitr/Quarto to evaluate. For when output_mode is set to "asis", content is inserted directly; otherwise, the expression is deparsed to text.

content_type

An optional human-readable type (e.g., "plot", "table", "qmd") used for ease of validation.

chunk_options

Named list of chunk options when output_mode = "chunk".

  • engine (default "r") to select language.

  • as_child = TRUE to write a child .qmd and include it with {{< include child_<slug>.qmd >}} instead of inlining the chunk.

  • child_dir optional subdirectory to store child files relative to the parent markdown file.

  • Any other knitr options, e.g. echo = FALSE, fig.width = 7.

Value

A "content_spec" object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
spec <- define_content(
  description     = "A plot of mtcars",
  placeholder_id  = "mtcarsplot",
  output_mode     = "chunk",
  content         = { plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg) },
  content_type    = "plot",
  chunk_options   = list(echo = FALSE, fig.width = 7)
)
} # }
